title: Crew medical event response
body: Cardiac event / decompression sickness / trauma: crew flight surgeon (CMOFS) directs response via voice loop. Affected crewmember stabilised in Soyuz/Crew Dragon. Emergency descent (within 24h) authorised if surgeon judges return necessary.
citation: ISS Crew Health Care System Operations Plan

title: Bone density loss countermeasure
body: Crew shall perform 2.5 hours per day exercise: ARED (resistive), CEVIS (cycle), T2 (treadmill). Compliance < 80 % triggers ground-team review; persistent non-compliance flagged in CMS for post-flight rehab planning.

title: GNSS position update rate
body: ISS GPS position fix is updated every 1 s nominal; gap > 60 s triggers diagnosis of GPS antenna or receiver. State vector propagated by inertial measurement during gap; uncertainty grows at ~0.5 m/s² × dt²/2.

title: ROSA solar array deployment
body: Roll-Out Solar Array (iROSA) deployment requires ISS attitude bias to minimise gravity-gradient torque, sun beta angle within 30 deg of optimum, no scheduled VV docking ±48h. Deployment commanded in 5 % increments with telemetry verification at each step.

title: Microgravity quiescent period
body: Microgravity-sensitive science requires quiescent attitude with crew-induced vibrations < 10⁻⁴ g. Crew exercise schedule defers during 8-hour quiescent windows; thruster firings prohibited unless emergency.

title: CMG total failure response
body: Loss of all 4 CMGs: ISS attitude held by Russian Segment thrusters; propellant burn rate ~ 200 kg/day. Plan within 48 h: replace failed CMGs (EVA), or accept reduced-attitude operations (off-pointing < 5 deg).

title: Quest airlock pre-EVA depress profile
body: Pre-EVA depressurisation: cabin 14.7 → 10.2 psi, hold 8 hours overnight (purge nitrogen), then 10.2 → 5.0 psi over 30 min. Slow-leak detection during each step via PCS pressure trending.
